title: Simulating One-Tape Time in Two-Fifths-Power Space
summary: We show that a fixed deterministic Turing machine with one writable tape and head can be simulated in $`O(T^{2/5}\mathop{\mathrm{polylog}}\nolimits (T+2))`$ work-space bits when a binary time cap T ≥ 2 is supplied. The simulator computes the finite-control and halting outcome by time T ; its running time is unrestricted. The result allows a fixed number of read-only input heads and requires a fixed accessor that supplies every initial writable and read-only symbol within distance T of the relevant head origin in polylogarithmic space.
